To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the personal computer industry, which is characterized by rapid technological innovation, has evolved from a product-oriented industry into a service-oriented industry; (b) the personal computer market has evolved from a market in which the product was the main focus of attention, to a service market in which the service is the main focus of customer attention.
(1) technological change in the PC market has been very rapid and (2) it has been characterized by the introduction of new products with a very high level of performance.
the evolution of personal computers has led to the development of multimedia services, which are the main drivers of innovation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evolution of personal computer technology and its implications for market structure and for relationships between manufacturers and users.
the impact of technological innovation on the personal computer industry.
the impact that technological innovation has on market structure and the relationship between firms and their customers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
technological change has modified the market structure and the market relationship between manufacturers and customers, but it has not changed the basic rules of the market.
technological innovation has modified the personal computer product from being a machine for processing data into a machine for providing services.
technological innovation has changed the personal computer market structure, which has moved from a product-oriented market to a service-oriented market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
technological innovation is modifying the personal computer industry, which is moving from a product-selling phase to a service-offering one.
technological change has increased the complexity of the personal computer market and the complexity of the relationship between firms and customers, and has modified the structure of the market.
the personal computer has become a tool for multimedia services, which has led to the development of a new market structure, in which the personal computer manufacturer is a provider of services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
technological evolution is modifying market relationships between firms and customers and that firms have to adapt their business models accordingly.
the market structure is evolving from a traditional one to a new one, where the role of the personal computer is changing.
the personal computer market is undergoing radical transformation.
